tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// gnod sbyin dgra lha'i rgyal po ya ba rkya bdun la bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga lha'i rnga chen zhes bya ba bzhugs// 'od snang 'bum phrag 'bar 'di byi ru'i ri// bskal pa'i me dang 'grogs sam rta mchog sku// 'on te snang srid dregs pa bran bkol phyir// gsung mchog khro bor nges pas phyag bgyi'o// gang gi bka' sdod myur mgyogs dregs pa'i rje// gnod sbyin tsi mar sprul pa'i sde tshogs bcas// dgyes pa'i mthu las phun tshogs dbyar gyi mgron// 'gugs byed bsang mchod lha yi rnga chen ldir// 'dir gnod sbyin rgyal po ya ba rkya bdun la bsang mchod 'bul bar 'dod pas/ rten dang bsang rdzas mchod gtor ci 'byor pa bshams la/ bsang mchod gzhan dang 'brel na mi dgos kyang 'di rkyang pa'i tshe/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi tshig gang rung re sngon du btang la/ spyan 'dren ni/ hrīḥrang nyid skad cig rta mgrin dbang rgyal sku// gzi brjid dus mtha'i me bzhin ches dmar ba'i// thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer pho nya 'phros// phyogs bcu mu med zhing nas bla ma dang*// yi dam rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*// btsan yul zangs thang dmar po zangs brag ri// spo mthor brtsegs pas mkha' yang 'bigs snyam can// ri rtser bya rgod lding ba'i gshog sgra 'byin// rked par mche sder gdug pa'i gcan gzan nyul// rtsa bar chu brag 'thab pa'i dba' rlabs kyi// lag pa stong gis zlos gar mkhar bsgyur ba'i// bsti gnas 'jigs rung bse mkhar smug po sogs// gar bzhugs gnas na ya ba rkya bdun ni// 'khor bcas mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// rings par tshur spyon badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ /bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ rin chen 'chang gi rtsig logs ba gam sgo// ches mtho bkod legs rgyal chen mig mi bzang*// lha gnas pho brang ljongs 'dir 'phos snyam gyi// phyi nang kun du khyab par brtan par bzhugs// gsol gdab pa ni/

hrīḥsteng phyogs kun gsal 'gram dkyus yangs pa'i ngos// gsung mchog khro bo'i dbang po rta mgrin la// dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas sras// chu 'dzin 'khrigs ltar bzhugs pa'i 'og rol na// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpag yas 'khor lo yis// snang srid dregs pa'i sde tshogs mnga' bsgyur yang*// rgyal kun gsung gi sprul pa rta mgrin gyis// dbang bsdus bstan pa bsrung bar gnyer gtad pa'i// bka' sdod dgra bla'i rgyal po tsi dmar can// sku mdog dmar ljang khro gtum 'jigs gzugs la// dmar ser ral pa'i me lces nam mkhar g.yengs// spyan dmar gtsubs pa'i me stag tsha tsha 'phro// rno dkar mche gtsigs ljags dmar glog tu 'khyug /gos bzang ban+dhu dzī wa ka mtshungs la// za 'og sngo khra'i gong lag byas pa bgos// rdo rje lu gu rgyud bstar ska rags las// sgro ldan brgya phrag gis gtams dong pa dang*// rgyud ldan gnam ru bdungs pa'i gzig shubs dpyangs// rgya skyes kyis dmar dar gyi la thod bcings// rang srung sra mkhregs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar// rnam par 'khyil pa'i phub chen rgyab tu bsnams// lag g.yas btsan zhags dmar pos dgra bo bcings// g.yon pas mdung dmar ba dan g.yo bas bsnun// rmig bzhi'i gom stabs mkhas pa'i cang shes rta// dar stan gser gyi sga srab mdzes par bcas// sku lha zhal gyi lha btsan dkar ser mdangs// za 'og dmar pos chas kyis sku la spras// mda' gzhu bkang nas dgra bo'i snying gar brdeg /gro shod bod kyi sgang dmar rgya skyes kyis// sku la byugs snyam le brgan 'jol ber can// ral gri zhags pas dgra bo 'chings shing brdeg /ra tsa gos sngon klu btsan dmar nag ni// dar dmar ral gur sbrul gyi ska rags dkris// mdung dar sbrul zhags nag pos lag zung brel// rdo ring dmar po'i grib btsan byi ru'i mdog /sku la dar dmar ber brgyan g.yas g.yon gyi// phyag zung bse yi mdung dang rgyu zhags 'phen// kaṃ ka thod nag bdud btsan ljang sngon mdangs// stong zil zhun mas btsos pa'i ber chen bklubs// dar nag ru mtshon 'phyar zhing 'bring zhags 'debs// rtsal gyi thog rgyug gri btsan khrag bzhin dmar// sku la dar ber zangs khrab dmar po bgos// zangs gri 'phyar zhing mdung dmar srid rtser bsgreng*// kun kyang tha dad dar gyi thod bcings byas// dku yi g.yas g.yon ska rags las dpyangs pa'i// dgra snying 'bigs pa'i mdas bkang dong ba dang*// sra ba'i gzhu ldan gzig shubs rnam par bkra// sag tis l+h+wam gyis sgeg pa'i bgrod byed zung*// gang 'dod gnas su skad cig gcig bgrod pa'i// rnga rngog zar bu g.yo ba'i rta mchog ni// rin chen sga srab spras pa'i steng na rtsen// gshog rtsal rdzogs pa'i bya nag bla na lding*// ri khyi spyang ki mang po rjes su 'brangs// 'khor du rigs mthun btsan dmar 'bum sde yis// rgyug 'dral byed pa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur// yo byad byin rlabs ni/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ rgyal ba'i gsang gsum rang bzhin 'bru gsum gyis// mchod rdzas bsang sbyangs ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul// mgron rigs dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas bsang rdzas rnams// 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas bskal par gnas gyur cig /mchod 'bul ni/ dag byed rlabs phreng g.yo ba'i mchod yon dang*// bung ba'i 'phur lding rtsen pa'i me tog tshal// dri 'dzin tshim byed lhan cig skyes sbyar spos// khor yug sgrib pa'i mun 'phrog sgron me bstar// gang la reg pa bde ster spos chu'i rdzing*// ro brgya ldan pa'i legs bris bza' ba'i bshos// snyan dbyangs sgra 'dzin 'jebs pa'i rol mo 'bul// gangs ri'i spun zla'i phye mar 'dod yon 'bul// gcig tu thub mchog bstan dang bstan 'dzin la// rnam par 'tshe ba'i bstan dgra dam nyams rnams// stong nyid snying rje'i mtshon chas yongs dbral te// yang 'byung med par dbyings su bsgral byung gi /khrag zhag rgya mtsho 'khyil pa'i ar+ghaṃ dang*// bstan dgra'i dbang po lnga yi me tog bzhad// tshil chen gsur gyi du ris mkha' la 'dri// zhun chen mar mes nyi ma'i 'od la 'phya// mkhris pa'i dri chab gser gyi lbu phreng 'grems// sha rus zhal zas zangs brag ri bor 'gran// rkang gling rnga chen 'ur sgras sa gsum g.yo// dmar gyi gtor ma bzhes shig khā hi hoḥ// sngo bsangs dus kyi bu mos sems can gyi// nyer 'tshor sprul pa'i sdong bu lo 'dab dang*// me tog snye ma g.yur du za ba yi// lha shing sna tshogs bsregs pa'i dri zhim sprin// kun gsal dga' ma'i bzhin ras yongs 'gengs pas// mi gtsang nyes skyon zad par za byed cing*// ci 'dod rtag tu 'jo ba'i bsang mchod 'dis// bla ma rta mgrin 'khor bcas bsang zhing mchod// dgra bla'i rgyal po tsi dmar bsang zhing mchod// sku lha zhal gyi lha btsan bsang zhing mchod// gro shod bod kyi sgang dmar bsang zhing mchod// rā tsa gos sngon klu btsan bsang zhing mchod// rdo ring dmar po grib btsan bsang zhing mchod// kaṃ ka thod nag bdud btsan bsang zhing mchod// rtsal gyi thog rgyug gri btsan bsang zhing mchod// pho nya yang sprul btsan gyi rigs gyur bsang*// gya nom bsang mchod bstabs pas mgron rigs rnams// nyams grib thugs dang 'gal ba kun byang nas// mkho dgur spyad pas dgyes rab rtser phyin nas// las bzhi'i phrin las sgrub la spro bar gyur// phrin las bcol ba ni/

hrīḥkhyed cag sngon rabs rta mgrin spyan snga ru// rang srog snying po phul nas rnam 'dren gyi// bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs de rjes nas// pad+ma saṃ bha ba sogs rgyal ba yi// gdung 'tshob rim pas bka' lung bdud rtsi byin// rdo rje'i tha tshig snying la bris don ltar// bstan pa'i bshad sgrub bstan 'dzin sku tshe dpal// mkhas tshul phrin las rgyas pa'i stong grogs mdzod// phrag dog dug gis myos pa'i mi bsrun sbrul// mthu stobs sgro rtsal rdzogs pa'i mkha' lding byas// lus srog zas su zos nas chos dbyings stor// las ngan rgyun thags bcad pa'i phrin las mdzod// bdag cag yon sbyor bcas rnams bar chad dgra// mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal go 'phang du// rtag brtan bde dga' dpal 'byor legs pa'i tshogs// phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du rgyas par mdzod// bsang mchod gzhan dang 'brel na mi dgos kyang*// 'di rkyang pa'i tshe gshegs gsol ni/ bsang mchod mgron du gnyer byas khyed cag rnams// dgyes 'dzum zla snang dkar pos khor yug gi /mun pa bkru ba yin snyam ngang nyid nas// rang gnas gshegs tshul ston cig badz+ra muḥ /zhes sam/ rten yod pa'i skabs yin na/ tshig rkang phyi ma de la/ rten 'dir brtan par bzhugs shig tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ zhes bsgyur ro// zhes gnod sbyin dgra lha'i rgyal po ya ba rkya bdun la bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga lha'i rnga chen zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gtsug lag kun gzigs bla ma mdo rgyud pa'am/ bde 'byung rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ rgyal ba gnyis pa dad sgrol e waṃ pa chen po/ yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i legs gsungs mkha' nyal zil mngar gyis 'tsho ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas shing sprel gyi lor sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/
slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
